design: 10 polysemous English lemmas × 6 noun senses each
selection_rule: Query all noun senses for each lemma in pinned oewn:2025.
Sort source senses deterministically by (lexfile, synset_id, sense_id).
Round-robin across distinct lexfiles to increase within-lemma semantic diversity.
Fill any remaining quota from the sorted unused senses.
Fail rather than silently substitute a lemma if it has fewer than six noun senses.
leakage_policy: All senses sharing a lemma are one indivisible group for later train/calibration/test assignment.
representativeness_warning: This is a grouped polysemy calibration set, not a frequency-representative sample of English concepts.
